title: Gost
description: Gost is a Minecraft server plug-in that combines cat and mouse, ghost and man, hide-and-seek... In the tense and exciting confrontation, experience the pursuit of life and death between human beings and ghosts.
body:
**🎮 Gost - Extreme Survival Confrontation Game**

Gost is a Minecraft server addon that combines multiple gameplays such as cat and mouse, ghost catch, peek-a-boo, CF biochemical mode, and more. Experience the life-and-death chase between humans and ghosts in a tense and exciting confrontation, using strategies and props to become the last survivor!

To know more --->https://726113394-cloud.github.io/Gost/

"In Gost's world, survival requires not only speed, but also wisdom and strategy."


This plugin was generated by @Little Mind from Space through the scriptirc plugin using AI. There is a high possibility that no further updates will be made. The content of the plugin is open source and can be authorized for the development of extended versions.
